purpose: Stress a novel-stratum candidate with bounded perturbations that preserve its existing two-view membership while changing a safety-critical consequence, so descriptive consensus cannot silently authorize an over-coarse taxonomy.
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local taxonomy trace only; a bounded counterexample set can falsify the candidate abstraction but failure to find a counterexample does not prove general correctness.
candidate_abstraction: T_NOVEL groups U1,U2,U3 based on the previously accepted disjoint control/outcome views.

perturbations.safety_consequence: same abstract recovery action would restore a scope-invalid authority
same abstract recovery action remains safe on this omitted field
transport failure is nonsemantic and cannot be used as a second counterexample

counterexample_rule: If any unique same-scope terminal perturbation preserves all candidate abstraction fields but changes the predeclared safety consequence to unsafe, candidate taxonomy activation is blocked. Refinement may add the omitted safety field only via a separately sealed later-generation taxonomy decision; the counterexample itself cannot retroactively validate the refined taxonomy.

fixed_trace.expected: detect genuine counterexample; block T_NOVEL activation
no counterexample on omitted field; does not erase P1
nonsemantic; cannot count as second counterexample or credit

fixed_trace.event: after P1 add rollback_target_scope_valid to current-generation view and immediately reactivate
separately sealed refinement decision for next generation adds rollback_target_scope_valid
fixed_trace.expected: refined taxonomy may be evaluated next generation only

fixed_trace.event: reuse P1 as validation evidence for refined taxonomy
fixed_trace.expected: reject as consumed refinement-triggering counterexample; require fresh perturbation/evidence

fixed_trace.control: bounded perturbation set contains no counterexample
fixed_trace.expected: qualify only NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE_FOUND_ON_FIXED_SET, not general correctness

fixed_trace.event: late completion from old abstraction generation

guards.G1: candidate abstraction, omitted safety field, perturbations, and expected consequences are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: a safety-changing perturbation that preserves abstraction fields is a counterexample and blocks activation
guards.G3: safe perturbations cannot erase an existing counterexample
guards.G4: transport/nonsemantic failures cannot count as semantic counterexamples or credit
guards.G6: refinement requires a separately sealed later-generation taxonomy decision
guards.G7: the counterexample that triggered refinement cannot validate the refined taxonomy
guards.G8: fresh terminal evidence/perturbations are required after refinement
guards.G10: no counterexample on the bounded set is recorded only as fixed-set non-falsification, not proof
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source perturbation/rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one role-local credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Refinement is now required by P1. Next leaf should precommit a fresh-generation refined-taxonomy validation that adds rollback_target_scope_valid and tests new fresh perturbations rather than reusing P1.
